response.rationale: Both translations match the English cue and sense. Indonesian lelucon is a noun meaning a joke or humorous utterance, while Malaysian Malay jenaka denotes a joke or humorous act/utterance. Lawak is also a valid Malaysian synonym and may be more colloquial in some contexts, but this does not make jenaka incorrect. The different-common-word relation is defensible; no false-friend contrast is required.
